profile.headline: Senior Engineer, Software Engineer, U.S. DoD Secret Security Clearance (Active)
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience designing and delivering secure, scalable, and innovative software solutions across aerospace, telecommunications, and technology industries. Skilled in C++, C#, Java, Python, and cloud integrations, I specialize in microservices, secure systems, and AI-driven applications.

At Boeing, I developed secure cross-domain data transfer systems, optimized real-time pipelines, and advanced automation initiatives—work recognized with the Boeing Exceptional Performance Award and BWIL Inspiring Women Award (2022). As a Team Lead at Simply Wireless, I drove API design, POS integration, database management, and mentorship of junior developers. My earlier roles at Seagate and Mettler-Toledo deepened my expertise in robotics, OCR, and embedded systems.

Highlights include:

- AI & Computer Vision: Vision Transformer–based OCR, medical imaging, fracture detection using CNN/ViT
- Enterprise & Cloud: REST/SOAP APIs, WCF, ASP.NET, XML/XSLT, cloud integrations
- Secure Software Development & Compliance/Policy: CSSLP-certified Training, DoD security standards, NSA directives, security documentation
- Leadership & Collaboration: Proven record mentoring teams, leading projects, and sharing knowledge

Beyond my career, I’ve led impactful projects like the mDocInABox portable health system (National microMedic Winner, 2013) and AI-powered humerus X-ray analysis pipeline. I am currently advancing my knowledge through the Artificial Intelligence Graduate Certificate at Stanford University (in progress) and am passionate about joining organizations that value continuous learning, professional growth, and education benefits to support lifelong development.

🔐 Active Secret Clearance

I am passionate about building resilient, secure, and future-ready systems while empowering teams to innovate and deliver lasting impact.

positions.title: Senior Engineer, Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop and maintain C++ and C# applications for real-time flight simulation and training systems. 
- Design and implement user interfaces using C# WPF to support simulator operations and improve user experience. 
- Develop back-end services and software components that support real-time simulation capabilities. 
- Perform unit and integration testing to ensure software quality, reliability, and performance. 
- Participate in Agile/Scrum development, contributing to sprint planning, code reviews, and continuous delivery. 
- Manage source code and CI/CD workflows using GitLab.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Remote)
positions.description:
- Contributed to the design and development of a secure cross-domain data transfer system enabling high-security data exchange across multiple classification levels. Including NSA.
- Implemented microservice-based architectures to support high-throughput, real-time data exchange between isolated networks.
- Designed and built a comprehensive testing platform, developed automation tests for product installation, created testing data, generated detailed testing reports, and authored technical documentation to validate software functionality and support team knowledge sharing.
- Conducted code reviews to ensure software quality, maintainability, and adherence to best practices.
- Optimized performance and resilience of file- and stream-based data pipelines, including imagery and operational data, while ensuring robust security and reliability standards.
- Successfully contributed to projects while working remotely, collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams across multiple locations.
- Recognized with BDS Boeing Exceptional Performance Award (2022), Inspiring Women in Leadership Award (2022) and Boeing Recognition Achievement Award, 2020 – Delivered software for NSA National Cross Domain Systems Management Office Certification testing deadline.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering (Team lead)
positions.description:
Development Role
- Designed and developed a first-party API (SOA) for Sprint Phone Activation and POS systems in stores using C#.
- Integrated software for POS devices using Java and C, ensuring seamless device functionality.
- Developed a warehouse management system to automate inventory, orders, and shipping across all seller affiliates, minimizing human error and delays in billing and fulfillment using C#, CA/AL, REST, JSON, XML, and EDI.
- Maintained and optimized databases supporting various retail operations.
- Database Management / Administrator Role
- Performed ad-hoc database fixes and troubleshooting to maintain smooth operations.
- Created and maintained stored procedures to support application and reporting needs.
- Managed routine database backups and archival processes to ensure data integrity.
Leadership Role
- Coordinated cross-functional teams including software, IT, retail, customer support, warehouse, third-party developers, contractors, and management to ensure project alignment and delivery.
- Authored technical documentation and user manuals to support the team and end-users.
- Conducted code reviews and guided developers on solutions and performance improvements.
- Trained and mentored developers, creating individual development plans and providing ongoing feedback to enhance skills and productivity.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained software for robotic arms used in production lines, improving production speed, reducing errors, and lowering maintenance costs.
- Worked on autonomous systems for robotic operations, enabling self-directed task execution.
- Collaborated with mechanical, electrical, and process engineers to integrate software with production line systems and optimize workflows.
- Implemented an OCR system using Vision Transformer (ViT) to accurately detect and recognize text in scanned documents.
- Designed and launched an internal web portal to report quality control test results, enabling the engineering team to quickly identify and address product issues.
- Enhanced inventory tracking by creating a web application frontend and reporting tool, improving visibility and process efficiency.
- Conducted ad-hoc data analysis and query operations to support decision-making and operational improvements.

projects.description: Improved the efficiency of image processing code in the “Humurus X-ray Analysis” program by implementing parallel programming using MPI.NET with C#.NET 2012.

projects.title: Perception Artificial Intelligence “Humerus X-ray Analysis”
projects.description:
- Developed an image classification pipeline to detect humerus bone fractures from X-ray images using CNNs and Vision Transformer (ViT).
- Achieved high diagnostic accuracy in distinguishing broken vs. intact bones.
- Collaborated with medical experts to validate model predictions, ensuring clinical reliability and interpretability.
